sources.finding: The --bg flag starts a background session and checks workspace trust; claude agents supports cwd and JSON listing.
Cross-session messaging and one notice on next idle/exit are native; same-machine main sessions; notification expires after 12 hours if no notice.
Unattached finished/waiting sessions are stopped after about an hour. Session/worktree behavior is separately documented.
